season.source: https://apps.web.maine.gov/parksearch/ (park_id=16) ('Season Open 9:00 a.m. to sunset daily from May 15 to October 15'), read 2026-11-02

values.note: Online reservations ran 5/18-9/13 in 2026; from 9/14 through the park's close all sites are first-come. Sites 14, 25, 32, 35, 39, 57 and 59 aren't reservable. Up to 14 nights per reservation. Call center 800-332-1501.

Map classes: S up to 20 ft, M up to 25, L up to 30, X up to 35, U over 35. S sites 19, 21, 22, 23, 36, 39, 46 and 48 won't fit a 23-ft rig. Sites 1 and 33 are administrative; 13, 15, 16 and 17 are walk-in tent.

facilities.source: https://apps.web.maine.gov/parksearch/ (park_id=16) (services list showers) + https://cg-public-prod.web.maine.gov/cg/cgimages/lamoine.jpg (restrooms, showers, dump station), read 2026-11-02

note: Oceanfront Maine state park campground on Frenchman Bay, ~8 mi SE of Ellsworth (near Acadia). 2 group areas; campground host. A few sites FCFS, including two near the bay. --AWH

awh_superseded.old: 62 single-family drive-in sites ... no hookups; drinking water, flush toilets, hot showers, dump station ... Per-site length classes on the official map run up to 45'; a 23-ft rig fits any M/L/X/U site. Open May 15-Oct 15. Reservable via campwithme.com ... RV Life: 3.5* / $$.
awh_superseded.source: Moved to fields: hookups, sites, facilities, season, booking, rating (https://cg-public-prod.web.maine.gov/cg/cgimages/lamoine.jpg, read 2026-11-02). Only the redundant run was dropped; the rest stays word for word.

summary: Confirmed 62 sites, season 05-15..10-15, showers, dump, some FCFS; added max stay 14, site classes. Note shortened (--AWH run the fields hold; awh_superseded). Fees stand.
flags: WATERFRONT 'bayview' stands though --AWH and the park page say 'oceanfront' ('Park views of Frenchman's Bay'). The shore-side loop road (~44.4538-44.4530,-68.3018 to -68.3005) runs ~25-40 m from the rocky shore over open grass, and the map's picnic-table symbols sit on the bay side: road and day use between pads and water. Outer sites 55M, 56M, 58M and 62M are the closest; 62M sits outside the loop on the Loop Trail and could be looked at from campsite photos, which are on the refused maine.gov KML. Not changed. 'Oceanfront' kept in AWH's words; say if it should go.
